question: Deficiency of which of the following causes colour blindness and poor vision?
solution:
Correct answer is__** Vitamin A.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vitamin A** deficiency may cause color blindness.
 
• Vitamin A insufficiency can result from **inadequate intake, fat malabsorption, or liver disorders**. 
 
• Attentiveness of preformed vitamin A are highest in **liver, fish, eggs, and dairy products**
 
• Vitamin A, **protects Eyes From Night Blindness** and Age-Related Decline.
 
• Vitamin A,supports a healthy immune system.
